A universal surveillance schedule or unsupported forced ranking would be unfair. No scored key is retained.

Parked: every candidate now targets the actual node, removing the misplaced-clip giveaway. The record proves a sampling miss but does not supply supported patient-specific criteria ranking representative core, FNA and properly localized excision. No source supports a universal phyllodes-node core preference.

Parked: the missing policy is supplied and blanket breast-volume permission is removed, but posterior-plane anatomy remains insufficient to rank the actual operations fairly.
